prepSteps.title: Create an Entro OCI user and API key
prepSteps.instruction: Create a user with Entro's read-only policies, add an API signing key, and record tenancy OCID, user OCID, fingerprint, and private key in the operator vault.
prepSteps.evidence: Identity shows the user, policy, and an API key fingerprint

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Create an Entro OCI user and API key
typedActions.preview: oci iam user get --user-id (inspect collision by name via list)
typedActions.mutation: oci iam user create, group/policy attach from Entro's read-only set, then oci iam user api-key upload; operator stores the PEM outside the session
typedActions.expectedChange: Identity shows the user, policy, and an API key fingerprint
typedActions.verification: oci iam user list --compartment-id <tenancyOcid> ; oci iam user api-key list --user-id <userOcid>
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Delete the API key and user created this run after Approve
